title: Axial force in five newly declared frame scenarios
solver_scope: New first-order 3D Timoshenko frame calculations on retained Rhino truss proportions. Native Karamba benchmark was a separate 17-member case; the 104-member results use the inspectable frame solver.
force_sign: Positive axial force means tension; negative means compression; |force| <= 0.01 kN is displayed as near zero.

cases.label: Retained 12
cases.load_case: Q: 10 kN downward at each of 18 interior lower chord nodes; no self-weight included
cases.geometry_interpretation: New 30 m computational scenario using the saved coordinate proportions. Original Rhino units are millimetres; no assertion of historical physical size. Duplicate coincident curves removed with source ID mapping retained.
cases.scope: New geometry/section/load exploration. First-order elasticity only; no self-weight in Q, joint eccentricity, local/member buckling, fatigue or physical test results.
